name: count_order
description: REQ-700 / GH #3737. The header of a count order (inventory taking): one org unit, a kind (full or selective), the planned period, the chair, a status and the issued document. status is draft, ordered, counting, counted, signed, posted or cancelled. org_unit_id is the scope column (decision 0076 R7). Master references (org unit, employee) are record ids checked in code (0076 R6), not foreign keys. cut_off_at and cutoff_seq are filled when the count is opened and sheet_document_id when it is closed (REQ-701). REQ-717: sheet_signed_at, differences_document_id, differences_number, differences_issued_at and differences_signed_at are filled by the signing and differences steps; old rows lack them. REQ-718: posting_document_id, posting_number and posting_issued_at are filled when the chair issues the posting record; old rows lack them. REQ-765: freeze_locations is the flag of the freeze mode (default false); freeze_started_at, freeze_until, freeze_ended_at, freeze_end_reason and freeze_state are the freeze fields (freeze_state is the lazily stored state, the read computes it from the data); old rows lack them.
